full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as first party filed an application under section 144 CrPC, where-upon police submitted a report and upon that police report the case was converted into a proceeding under section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure on 6-7-71. It was numbered as Miscellaneous Case No. 41 of 1971 and the proceeding land was attached and CO (Rev), Boalkhali was appointed as receiver of the disputed land. Both the parties flied their written statements.
